wiki.content: “Stars” marks PinkPantheress second song sampling Just Jack’s 2007 debut single, “Starz in Their Eyes,” alongside her 2021 song “Attracted To You.” In this context, rather than sampling the melody of “Starz in Their Eyes,” “Stars” shares multiple similarities on the lyrics. According to an interview with The Fader, she has openly expressed the importance behind the sample and the song itself, stating: "I think it’s cool. If a massive chunk of the chorus had been sampled I might feel differently but as it’s the instrumental section I’m happy. A lot of people might not recognize the sample so it just makes me smile. It was a nice surprise." Read more on Last.fm. User-contributed text is available under the Creative Commons By-SA License; additional terms may apply.
